items.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: My father’s name was William – William Barron, Sr.

ctx.x: What were your parents’ names? And any occupations, your father’s occupation?

My father’s name was William – William Barron, Sr. He worked in a steel factory in Philly – not steel, but a place where they made metal files, called Nicholson File Company. My mother was pretty much a housewife, homemaker, although I do remember her working one time at the Goldman Theater in Philly, cleaning. During that time, I used to get to go to the movies with her for free.
